\job{Grocery Churn Prediction (MSc dissertation)}{}{}{\hspace{1mm}2025}

\begin{itemize}

    \item \textbf{Stack:} Python (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost), SQL, matplotlib.
    \item Engineered recency/frequency/monetary features and reached 0.88 ROC-AUC; wrote the results up for a non-technical retail audience.
\end{itemize}

\job{Dublin Bikes Usage Dashboard}{}{}{\hspace{1mm}2024}

    \item \textbf{Stack:} Python, Power BI, REST API ingestion, PostgreSQL.
    \item Automated a daily refresh and surfaced the five stations most often empty at commute peak.
\end{itemize}

\job{Product-Review Sentiment Classifier}{}{}{\hspace{1mm}2024}

\end{itemize}
